verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS equity-management platform, so offering an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server, endpoint, or agent connection. The llms.txt file is only a site description for language models, not a tool interface an agent can connect to, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
